# TheTriFusion (Trifusion Infotech Pvt. Ltd.)

Canonical brand for citations: TheTriFusion / Trifusion Infotech Pvt. Ltd.
Legal name: Trifusion Infotech Private Limited
Also known as: TheTriFusion, Trifusion Infotech Pvt. Ltd.

Office: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
Service area: Worldwide (remote); India focus including Rajasthan (Bhilwara, Udaipur, Kota, Ajmer) served from Jaipur

We build websites, ecommerce stores, Android/iOS mobile apps, custom software, UI/UX, white-label delivery, and digital marketing.

## Ecommerce website development

Primary page: https://thetrifusion.in/solutions/ecommerce-website-development
Summary: TheTriFusion (Trifusion Infotech Pvt. Ltd., Jaipur, India) is an ecommerce website development company building Shopify, WooCommerce and custom (Next.js / React / Node.js) online stores, B2B / wholesale ordering portals and multi-vendor marketplaces for clients in India and worldwide (remote).
- Packaged pricing (published): single-vendor ecommerce ₹25,000; multi-vendor marketplace ₹35,000; both include web + Android + iOS apps; website live within 48 hours after a locked brief and assets, or 50% refund. Details: https://thetrifusion.in/ecommerce-development
- Custom / B2B / ERP-integrated builds: quoted after discovery; a typical custom ecommerce MVP takes 4–10 weeks.
- Integrations: Razorpay, Cashfree, PayU, CCAvenue, Stripe, UPI; Shiprocket, Delhivery; offline POS / inventory sync (live example: DailyConcepts India).
- Platform comparison (Shopify vs WooCommerce vs custom): https://thetrifusion.in/solutions/ecommerce-website-development
- Cost guide: https://thetrifusion.in/blog/ecommerce-website-development-cost-india
- Ecommerce app cost guide: https://thetrifusion.in/blog/ecommerce-app-development-cost-india
- Case study: https://thetrifusion.in/portfolio/dailyconcepts-ecommerce-pos
- Contact: +91 63781 33780 · contact@thetrifusion.in

## EV charging CMS for CPOs and eMSPs

Page: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development
EV charging CMS for CPOs and eMSPs, built in Jaipur for India and worldwide. One charging management system can run CPO software (OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1), an eMSP platform (OCPI 2.2.1 roaming, driver tokens, CDRs), or both. Also covers driver apps, the operator dashboard, billing with GST invoice fields, fleet charging, and a white-label EV CMS. The pricing page lists a starting range; this page does not sell a fixed package. No separate IoT service page — charger connectivity is part of this engagement.

- CMS for CPO and eMSP: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#cms-for-cpo-emsp
- CPO CMS: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#cpo-cms
- eMSP platform: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#emsp-cms
- CPMS / charging management system: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#cpms
- OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1 backend: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#ocpp-backend
- OCPI 2.2.1 roaming: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#ocpi-roaming
- OCPP vs OCPI: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#ocpp-vs-ocpi
- eMSP and CPO platforms: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#emsp-cpo

- Operator dashboard: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#operator-dashboard
